Container.Name: ainulindale
Container.Overview: Weekly music discovery for Navidrome in one container: a ProtonVPN WireGuard tunnel (gluetun), slskd for Soulseek, and Explo driven by a nightly tick that imports ListenBrainz Weekly Exploration plus its own daily/weekly/monthly discovery mixes built from ListenBrainz data, then prunes old playlists. Starred tracks are kept.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: gluetun, slskd and Explo state plus the downloaded binaries

Config.Name: Music library
Config.Description: The same folder Navidrome reads as its library. Shared on Soulseek; downloads go to slskd/ and explo/ inside it

Config.Name: Ainulindale web UI
Config.Description: Status, runs and Soulseek search; log in with the slskd web username and password

Config.Name: Explo web UI port
Config.Description: Only with Explo web UI = true

Config.Name: WireGuard private key
Config.Description: ProtonVPN: account → VPN → Downloads → WireGuard, a P2P server

Config.Name: Port forwarding
Config.Description: true if your Proton plan/server supports it; better Soulseek results

Config.Name: Soulseek username
Config.Description: Do not use this account anywhere else at the same time

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Its LAN IP and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.81:4533; the VPN firewall is opened for exactly this address

Config.Name: ListenBrainz token
Config.Description: From listenbrainz.org/settings; needed for the discovery mixes

Config.Name: Discovery mixes
Config.Description: Any of daily,weekly,monthly (slower = deeper). weekly:40 sets the track count; off disables

Config.Name: Avoid tags
Config.Description: Comma-separated genres/tags the mixes never pick

Config.Name: Prefer tags
Config.Description: Comma-separated genres/tags the mixes lean towards

Config.Name: Discovery schedule
Config.Description: Cron, in the container's time zone

Config.Name: Weeks to keep
Config.Description: Newest N playlists per source (days for the daily mix); older playlists and files are pruned, starred tracks move to Keepers/

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: slskd and Explo run as this user

Config.Name: Explo web UI
Config.Description: Viewing only; set a login below when on

Config.Name: Run on start
Config.Description: One tick at startup; already-imported weeks are skipped

Config.Name: Firewall outbound subnets
Config.Description: Only if the Navidrome URL is a hostname, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24

Config.Name: Prune files
Config.Description: false removes old playlists but keeps files

Config.Name: Require slskd
Config.Description: Skip a run instead of filling it from YouTube when slskd is down

Config.Name: YouTube API key
Config.Description: Optional: Explo's YouTube fallback, when a track is not on Soulseek
